terminal_cloud.accounting_note: The provider confirms a terminal state but supplies no finish timestamp. Creation through the recorded terminal observation is charged as a conservative upper bound; actual allocation duration is unknown.

record.billing_estimate_policy: Conservative upper bound: charge job creation through recorded observation of terminal CANCELED state; provider omits finish timestamp. Round each job up to full minutes including hardware and port. Actual allocation may be shorter; invoice not verified.

metric_definitions.configuration_range: Observed min/max across repeats, not a confidence interval.
metric_definitions.latency: Reported P99 E2E from measured cohort; small-sample warning retained.
metric_definitions.quality_goodput: Correct SLO-compliant measurement-window completions divided by measurement seconds.
metric_definitions.search_cost_axis: Actual raw trial allocation plus its uniquely tagged cloud overhead, per method.
metric_definitions.whole_trial_efficiency: Same window-correct numerator divided by whole attributed trial allocation; distinct from window goodput.

search.cost_note: Each raw trial plus its one unique method-tagged global-ledger overhead. Shared setup is separate; derived totals are not additional ledger charges.

method_cap_audit.interpretation: closed_loop admission uses base trial accelerator charges. Method-tagged cloud overhead is assigned afterward; the same declared amount is audited against fully attributed totals, not asserted as an enforced end-to-end resource cap. Actual excess is retained without changing experiment completion status.

optimizer_timing.resource_note: Policy CPU/wall timers are descriptive separate clocks, not extra accelerator debits. Reserved GPU wall during this work is already in the uniquely assigned cloud-overhead events. Global ledger optimizer_cpu_seconds may remain zero.
optimizer_timing.scope: Recorded SearchPolicy.choose process CPU and elapsed wall timers, including fitting/acquisition/artifact work inside that call; not all tokenizer, setup, policy loading or later policy saving CPU time.

search.uncertainty_note: One search seed per method; no between-search-seed confidence interval. Configuration ranges are descriptive.
